description: Tahap 5 (T5.6–T5.8 + T5.9) — Demo seed, README, and PWA: create demo seed data matching Req §5 example, reset script, comprehensive README, and full PWA setup (manifest, service worker, safe-area, status bar, back button). Requires FEAT-006 (all features stable). T5.10 (APK wrap) is a separate chore that requires external tooling — documented in README but not automated here.
steps: 1. Create `src/db/seed-demo.ts`: inserts a complete demo dataset matching Req §5 — one pertemuan with the 6 example players (Andi, Budi, Cici, Dedi, Eko, Fani), sesi configurations that produce Andi Rp1.000, Budi Rp1.000, Cici Rp15.000, Dedi Rp11.000, Eko Rp0, Fani Rp12.000, corresponding peserta_pertemuan records with correct status, iuran records for Member players, and matching transaksi_kas. Script resets demo data idempotently (delete-then-insert for demo grup). (T5.6)
2. Create `src/db/reset.ts`: drops and recreates all tables for the grup (use CASCADE), then re-runs seed.ts. For dev/test use only — guard with `NODE_ENV !== 'production'` check. (T5.6)

3. Create `public/manifest.json` with PWA manifest: name 'ShuttleCashFlow', short_name 'Shuttle', display 'standalone', start_url '/', theme_color matching the brand primary color from design tokens, background_color white, icons array with at least 192x192 and 512x512 PNG icons (create placeholder icons in `public/icons/`). (T5.9)

4. Create `src/app/layout.tsx` meta tags for PWA: add `<link rel='manifest'>`, apple-mobile-web-app-capable, apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style, theme-color meta, viewport with `viewport-fit=cover`. Add `pb-safe` padding utility or env(safe-area-inset-bottom) for bottom nav on notched phones. (T5.9)

5. Create `public/sw.js`: minimal service worker that intercepts fetch but passes all requests to network (network-only strategy — no offline caching, app stays online-only). Register it in `src/app/layout.tsx` via a client component `src/components/ServiceWorkerRegistrar.tsx`. (T5.9)

6. Ensure bottom navigation respects safe-area: add `padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)` to the BottomNav component in `src/components/layout/BottomNav.tsx`. Add `safe-area` CSS utility in `tailwind.config.ts` if not present. (T5.9)

7. Create `README.md` at project root with sections: Overview, Tech Stack, Local Setup (prerequisites, clone, pnpm install, .env.local setup from .env.example with Neon URL instructions, pnpm db:generate, pnpm db:migrate, pnpm db:seed, pnpm dev), Environment Variables table, DB Migrations (how to create and run), Creating First Admin (run seed + login instructions), Deploy to Vercel (link Neon env var, set NODE_ENV=production, run migration on first deploy), PWA Installation (Android instructions), APK Build (T5.10: manual steps using PWABuilder or Bubblewrap, link to tool docs, note about keystore backup). (T5.8)

8. Verify Vercel deployment config: check `vercel.json` has correct buildCommand ('pnpm build'), installCommand ('pnpm install'), outputDirectory ('.next'). Confirm that `pnpm build` succeeds end-to-end. Document in README that `pnpm db:migrate` must be run once after first Vercel deploy via Neon console or a one-off migration command. (T5.7 config part only — no actual deploy)
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm db:seed:demo` inserts the Req §5 example dataset successfully
`pnpm db:reset` completes without error (when DATABASE_URL is set)
`public/manifest.json` exists and is valid JSON with all required PWA fields
Service worker registered in layout.tsx via ServiceWorkerRegistrar component
`pnpm build` completes with zero errors after this FEAT
